title: Native Shell AST Schema
description: An abstract syntax tree (AST) schema for a Native Shell.

schema-version.description: The version of the schema for this AST.  This is used to ensure compatibility with the parser and runtime.

version.description: The version of the AST schema.

events.title: Event Name List
events.description: The event names that nodes can trigger.  These construct a named group of event brokers, which are referenced by the nodes through the index.  Eventually, this may have a parameter list, but for the moment, events can carry a message and/or a code.

items.title: Event Name
items.description: An event name that can be triggered by a node.

name.description: The event index that triggers this action list.

text.description: The text description of the event.  This is used for debugging and logging.

nodes.title: Node List
nodes.description: The nodes in the AST.  Each node is a module with a backing builder.

file.description: The file where the node is defined.

line.description: The line number where the node is defined.

column.description: The column number where the node is defined.

Node.title: Node
Node.description: A node in the AST.  Each node has a name, a type, and a list of actions.

module.description: The build implementation for the node.

streams.description: The streams for the node.  This shows how to link this node to other nodes.

items.title: Stream
items.description: A stream that connects this node to another node.

name.description: The name of the stream, if associated with a named stream.

mode.description: The type of the stream.  Even for modules where this maps to a fixed stream, this helps ensure the script's assumptions and the module align.

to-node.description: The name of the node that this stream connects to.  This is used to link the node to other nodes.

to-stream.description: The FD or named stream of the node that this stream connects to.  This is used to link the node to other nodes.

initial-parameters.title: Initial Parameters
initial-parameters.description: The compile-time parameters for the node.  These parameters are static and help initialize the module.

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.title: Parameter
^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: A compile-time parameter for the node.

exit-actions.title: Exit Actions
exit-actions.description: A list of actions that are triggered when the node exits.

items.title: Exit Action
items.description: An action that is triggered when the node exits.

code-start.description: Exit code range start (inclusive) for triggering this action list.  Do not set for no lower bound.

code-end.description: Exit code range end (inclusive) for triggering this action list.  Do not set for no upper bound.

event-listeners.title: Event Listeners
event-listeners.description: A list of event listeners that are triggered by the node.  This is a named group of event brokers.

items.title: Event Listener
items.description: An event listener that is triggered by the node.

name.description: The event name that triggers this action list.

OrderedActions.title: Ordered Actions
OrderedActions.description: A list of actions that can be triggered by a node.  This is a named group of event brokers.

Action.title: Action
Action.description: An action that can be triggered by a node.  This is a named group of event brokers.

name.description: The name of the action.  Used only for debugging.

oneOf.title: Run Node Handler
oneOf.description: Execute a handler on the current node.

handler.description: The name of the handler to run on the current node until the handler completes.

oneOf.title: Spawn Node
oneOf.description: Requests the parallel execution of a node, either start it or restart it.  If it's currently running, this will wait for it to finish and reuse its exit code.

oneOf.title: Ensure Node Started At Least Once
oneOf.description: If the node has never started, then start it through the action reference.  Otherwise, do nothing.

oneOf.title: Wait For Node
oneOf.description: Wait for a node to finish executing.  This will block until the node's execution exits.  If it has already finished exiting, this will continue without waiting.

for-exit.title: For Exit
for-exit.description: Behavior for the next action in the list depending on the executed node's exit code.

items.title: Exit Behavior
items.description: Behavior based on the node's exit code.

code-start.description: Exit code range start (inclusive) for triggering this action list.  Do not set for no lower bound.

code-end.description: Exit code range end (inclusive) for triggering this action list.  Do not set for no upper bound.

oneOf.title: Send Event
oneOf.description: Send an event to the event broker.  It has either a string message, or an integer code, or both, or neither.

message.description: The message to send with the event.

code.description: The integer code to send with the event.  Associated with a signal or exit code or something else.

message.description: Message to report to the user.

exit-code.description: The exit code to return from the script engine.

ActionEndBehavior.description: The behavior to take based on the exit code of the node.  'run' means run the next action, 'skip-next' means skip the next action, 'skip-all' means skip all remaining actions, and 'abort-script' means terminate the script.

items.title: Action Parameter
items.description: A parameter for the action. Must provide exactly one of a value or a value-array.

ComputedValue.title: Computed Value
ComputedValue.description: A value that is computed at runtime.  This can be a constant value, a lookup from a node's state, or an array of values, or an operation on a list of values.

LookupStringValue.title: Lookup String Value
LookupStringValue.description: A string value that is looked up from a node's state.

ListIndexStringValue.title: List Indexed String Value
ListIndexStringValue.description: Extracts a single indexed string from a string list.  A default must be given, in case the index is out of bounds.

MapKeyStringValue.title: Map Keyed String Value
MapKeyStringValue.description: A key's string value from a map.  A default must be given, in case the key is not found.

SubStringValue.title: Sub-String Value
SubStringValue.description: Extract an internal part of another string.  The 'count' field cannot be used with 'end'.  If 'start' is not given, then it defaults to 0, and if 'end' or 'count' are not given, then it defaults to the end of the string.

ConcatenatedStringValue.title: Concatenated String Value
ConcatenatedStringValue.description: A string value that is the concatenation of multiple string values.

NumberToStringValue.title: Number to String Value
NumberToStringValue.description: A string value that is the string representation of a number.
NumberToStringValue.$comment: We may want to expand the format into an explicit definition so it does not require additional parsing.  At the moment, this is the printf format string.

BooleanToStringValue.title: Boolean to String Value
BooleanToStringValue.description: A string value that is the string representation of a boolean.

ListToStringValue.title: List to String Value
ListToStringValue.description: A string value that is the string representation of a list.

MapToStringValue.title: Map to String Value
MapToStringValue.description: A string value that is the string representation of a map.

LookupNumberValue.title: Lookup Number Value
LookupNumberValue.description: A number value that is looked up from a node's state.

ArithmeticValue.title: Arithmetic Value
ArithmeticValue.description: A number value that is the result of an arithmetic operation on two or more number values.

ListIndexNumberValue.title: List Indexed Number Value
ListIndexNumberValue.description: Extracts a single indexed number from a string list.  A default must be given, in case the index is out of bounds.

MapKeyNumberValue.title: Map Keyed Number Value
MapKeyNumberValue.description: A key's number value from a map.  A default must be given, in case the key is not found.

LookupBooleanValue.title: Lookup Boolean Value
LookupBooleanValue.description: A boolean value that is looked up from a node's state.

LogicalBooleanValue.title: Logical Boolean Value
LogicalBooleanValue.description: A boolean value that is the result of a logical operation on two or more boolean values.

ListIndexBooleanValue.title: List Indexed Boolean Value
ListIndexBooleanValue.description: Extracts a single indexed boolean from a string list.  A default must be given, in case the index is out of bounds.

MapKeyBooleanValue.title: Map Keyed Boolean Value
MapKeyBooleanValue.description: A key's boolean value from a map.  A default must be given, in case the key is not found.

LookupStringListValue.title: Lookup String List Value
LookupStringListValue.description: A string list value that is looked up from a node's state.

SplitStringValue.title: Split-String Value
SplitStringValue.description: Turns a string into a string array, splitting items by a specific string.

RangeStringListValue.title: Range String List Value
RangeStringListValue.description: Selects a sub-sequence of values from an array.  If the 'count' or 'end' fields are not given, then it defaults to the end of the list.  If the 'start' field is not given, then it defaults to 0.

ConstantStringListValue.title: Constant String List Value
ConstantStringListValue.description: A constant string list value.  Can include expanding a sub-list within the list.

LookupNumberListValue.title: Lookup Number List Value
LookupNumberListValue.description: A number list value that is looked up from a node's state.

RangeNumberListValue.title: Range Number List Value
RangeNumberListValue.description: Selects a sub-sequence of values from an array.  If the 'count' or 'end' fields are not given, then it defaults to the end of the list.  If the 'start' field is not given, then it defaults to 0.

ConstantNumberListValue.title: Constant Number List Value
ConstantNumberListValue.description: A constant number list value.  Can include expanding a sub-list within the list.

LookupBooleanListValue.title: Lookup Boolean List Value
LookupBooleanListValue.description: A boolean list value that is looked up from a node's state.

RangeBooleanListValue.title: Range Boolean List Value
RangeBooleanListValue.description: Selects a sub-sequence of values from an array.  If the 'count' or 'end' fields are not given, then it defaults to the end of the list.  If the 'start' field is not given, then it defaults to 0.

ConstantBooleanListValue.title: Constant Boolean List Value
ConstantBooleanListValue.description: A constant boolean list value.  Can include expanding a sub-list within the list.

LookupStringMapValue.title: Lookup String Map Value
LookupStringMapValue.description: A string map value that is looked up from a node's state.

UnionStringMapValue.title: Union String Map Value
UnionStringMapValue.description: A string map value that is the union of multiple string map values.

ConstantStringMapValue.title: Constant String Map Value
ConstantStringMapValue.description: A constant string map value.  Can include expanding a sub-map within the map.  This also includes a 'null' value for the key to allow blanking out values if used in a union.

LookupNumberMapValue.title: Lookup Number Map Value
LookupNumberMapValue.description: A number map value that is looked up from a node's state.

UnionNumberMapValue.title: Union Number Map Value
UnionNumberMapValue.description: A number map value that is the union of multiple number map values.

ConstantNumberMapValue.title: Constant Number Map Value
ConstantNumberMapValue.description: A constant number map value.  Can include expanding a sub-map within the map.  This also includes a 'null' value for the key to allow blanking out values if used in a union.

LookupBooleanMapValue.title: Lookup Boolean Map Value
LookupBooleanMapValue.description: A boolean map value that is looked up from a node's state.

UnionBooleanMapValue.title: Union Boolean Map Value
UnionBooleanMapValue.description: A boolean map value that is the union of multiple boolean map values.

ConstantBooleanMapValue.title: Constant Boolean Map Value
ConstantBooleanMapValue.description: A constant boolean map value.  Can include expanding a sub-map within the map.  This also includes a 'null' value for the key to allow blanking out values if used in a union.
